name: ETHICS
description: ETHICS is a benchmark dataset designed to assess language models' understanding of basic concepts of morality, spanning justice, well-being, duties, virtues, and commonsense morality. It requires models to predict widespread moral judgments about diverse text scenarios, connecting physical and social world knowledge to value judgments.
reputation: A widely cited ethics benchmark in NLP, often used as a standard test of moral reasoning and commonsense value judgments.
notes: Focuses on moral knowledge and value judgments; aims to steer chatbot outputs and regularize reinforcement learning agents.
